title: Configure Drizzle ORM with SQLite
description: Set up the Drizzle ORM configuration files: the database client (src/db/index.ts), the migration runner (src/db/migrate.ts), and the Drizzle config file (drizzle.config.ts). Creates the data directory and initializes the SQLite database file.
acceptanceCriteria: `drizzle.config.ts` exists and points to the correct schema and output directory
`data/` directory is created and included in `.gitignore`
`src/db/migrate.ts` can be run to apply migrations without error
TypeScript compiles without errors in the db directory

steps.description: Create data directory and add it to .gitignore
steps.details: Create `./data/` directory. Add `data/` and `data/*.db` to `.gitignore` so the SQLite database file is not committed. Also add `.env.local` to .gitignore if not already present.

Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and confirm no TypeScript errors in the db directory. At this stage, schema.ts does not exist yet — create a temporary empty export or add schema creation as a dependency (TASK-3).

technicalNotes: Use `drizzle-orm/better-sqlite3` (not the edge or neon variants) since this is a local Node.js app.
The `data/` directory must exist before the database client is instantiated — create it in the startup path.
Supabase migration path (v2): swap to `drizzle-orm/postgres-js`, update drizzle.config.ts dialect to 'postgresql'. Only this file + schema.ts + repository.ts change.
